messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up — I opened a tiny PR to fix several SDK snippets in the docs: Python streaming sync/async mismatch, TS abort-signal example, and Go cursor pagination rename. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
matt: sending a quick look now. which files?
elaine: docs/guides/streaming.md (python), docs/snippets/typescript/streaming.md (browser abort), docs/snippets/go/pagination.md (cursor name). I noticed the py example still uses the old context-manager API that was removed in py-client v0.9.
matt: ah yeah — that will break users. We should prefer an `async` example and optionally show a tiny sync wrapper for blocking apps.
ravi: Go pagination also references `NextCursor` in the example response struct — SDK returns `next_cursor` (snake_case). Users copy-pasting hit runtime unmarshall errors.
sophie: TS streaming example forgot to pass the AbortSignal into the fetch call, so in browser demos aborting didn't cancel the stream. simple fix: wire controller.signal into fetch.
elaine: proposed python snippet (async-first):
```python
# async streaming example
async for chunk in client.stream_chat(model="rwd-mini", messages=msgs):
    if chunk.delta:
        print(chunk.delta)
```
matt: that's good. For sync users we can add a small helper right after: `for chunk in anyio.from_async(client.stream_chat(...)):` or show `client.stream_chat_sync(...)` if available. but avoid the removed context manager.
ravi: pushed a patch to my branch to rename the Go struct keys in the snippet and updated the example response JSON to "next_cursor": "abc123". PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/483/files
sophie: PR comment on the TS file with the exact line to change — added code suggestion: 
```ts
const controller = new AbortController();
const res = await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', body: body, signal: controller.signal });
```
elaine: thanks — I also added a tiny unit test that renders the snippets and checks they compile in the snippets harness. CI flaked once on Windows for the Go example (path separators) — re-ran the job.
matt: CI green now. left one nit: mention that `AbortController` isn't available in some older Node versions — suggest `undici` or node 18+ runtime.
elaine: added a short note and a link to the runtime compatibility table. doc-bot: Deploy preview available at https://deploy-preview-482--docs.redwood.ai — checks: linkcheck OK, snippet-lint passed.
ravi: small nit in pagination.md: the header anchor changed, so updated any broken internal links to `#cursor-pagination` in the same PR.
sophie: merged my TS fix to the PR branch.
matt: reviewed and pushed one small fix to the python snippet to use `asyncio.run(...)` in the example wrapper so new users can copy-paste.
elaine: green light from me, merging in ~30m unless there are objections. :eyes:
matt: LGTM, go for it.
ravi: all good from my side.
sophie: good to merge.
elaine: merged main -> docs and published. thanks everyone! :tada:
doc-bot: Published docs at https://docs.redwood.ai/streaming (cache may take ~5m).
elaine: follow-up: I'll open a separate migration guide for py v0.8->0.9 changes with expanded examples and a deprecation note. will tag SDK folks for cross-check.
